items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: He's the one who used to get it fixed for me.

ctx.x: New Orleans do it? When it was Grunewald, you see, Mr. A, I'm shocked at Grunewald, another man. He used to repair it for me. Grunewald? Do you know any of those instruments repairmen there?
Well I don't know, Werleins is the one I always think about. Mr. Eckert, Mr. Eckert. Oh, Eckert, yeah. Lewis Eckert.
He's the one who used to get it fixed for me. And when I went to Grunewald, well then I never had no trouble there yet. What were the prices of those instruments
